title: Engineering Summer Program
sponsor: University of Wisconsin-Madison College of Engineering
who_text: High school sophomores and juniors who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents, have finished algebra and geometry, and have at least a 3.0 unweighted GPA
description: A free three-week live-in program at UW-Madison for students who like math, science, and engineering. Housing and meals are included. You take classes, do hands-on workshops, visit companies, and get mentoring from faculty.

title: High School Freshwater Scholars
pay_text: Stipend of $1750 paid in two installments
who_text: Students currently enrolled in high school, including graduating seniors; students 15 or younger need a work permit
description: A paid summer research internship where you work 120 hours with a UW-Green Bay mentor on water science projects. You also go on group field trips to learn about water careers. Details for the 2027 program are expected in March.

title: Wisconsin Rural Scholars Program
sponsor: University of Wisconsin-Madison College of Agricultural and Life Sciences
who_text: Rising high school sophomores, juniors, and seniors, aimed at students from rural school districts
description: A five-day live-in program at UW-Madison where you explore agriculture and life science programs, research, and college life. There is no cost; meals, fees, and lodging are covered. Students often come as a group with a teacher from their district.
